title: Boeing 737 Stall Escape manoeuvre, why MAX needs MCAS!!
summary: Mentour Pilot, a 737 instructor, explains the approach-to-stall and escape manoeuvre and why the 737 MAX needs MCAS while the 737NG did not. He covers the jackscrew and pitch behavior in terms a general viewer can follow.
why: HN people recommend it as an easy-to-understand pilot's explanation of the 737 MAX MCAS issue.

quote.text: It's not very technical, but very easy to understand.
